policy_comparison.interpretation: Policy v2.1 produces event candidates, not confirmed facts. Zero routed review tasks on this small set does not establish safety: high-threshold uncertainty and unlisted signals miss preliminary positives.

latency_ms.caveat: descriptive; small synthetic sample, not a service-level guarantee

limitations: 40 cases came from a previously visible, unclassified synthetic pool; this is not blind.
All labels were drafted by one curator and have not been human-adjudicated.
Per-category supports are only 2 to 4 for most event types.
Choice/Noul scores are treated as scores at the configured cutoffs, not proof of calibrated real-world probabilities.
Threshold sweep is descriptive and must not be used as production calibration.

likely_taxonomy_or_annotation_boundaries.observation: Jev returned both trade_restriction and regulation_tax_change as positive for trade quotas/limits.
likely_taxonomy_or_annotation_boundaries.minimal_proposal: Clarify that regulation_tax_change requires fiscal/tax rules; explicitly exclude import/export quotas and embargoes, which belong to trade_restriction.

likely_taxonomy_or_annotation_boundaries.observation: price_cost_change scored 0.81 although the planned tariff change was cancelled and the old price remained.
likely_taxonomy_or_annotation_boundaries.minimal_proposal: Make completion/effectiveness a necessary criterion and add a negative example for cancelled or merely proposed price changes.

likely_taxonomy_or_annotation_boundaries.observation: shortage_capacity_constraint recall was 0/2 at 0.8; Jev scored 0.34 and 0.58. One label concerns specialist shortage and one concerns low stock alongside a delivery/production disruption.
likely_taxonomy_or_annotation_boundaries.minimal_proposal: Add contrastive examples that separate insufficient stock/capacity, delayed inbound supply, and realized production cuts; adjudicate whether specialist shortage belongs in this event or labor_workforce_event.

likely_taxonomy_or_annotation_boundaries.observation: both preliminary legal_enforcement positives were missed (scores 0.10 and 0.16).
likely_taxonomy_or_annotation_boundaries.minimal_proposal: Review the intended scope: regulator information requests and a court rejecting a claim may not match an enforcement-only reading. Add paired include/exclude cases only after human adjudication.

error_patterns_and_next_steps.threshold_readout: On this dataset only, lowering event cutoff from 0.8 to 0.7 changes FP from 3 to 10 and micro-F1 from 0.861 to 0.800; do not lower on this same set. At unlisted cutoff 0.5 the existing sweep finds 2/2 draft positives but also 18 FP, so a lower cutoff is not a safe fix.
recommended_next_steps: Human-adjudicate the disputed labels and event boundaries before treating any metric as model error.
Keep taxonomy 0.3 and the current pilot outputs immutable; submit a separate taxonomy proposal for review, then use a new authorized matched live pilot.
Preserve Noul scores and abstain state downstream; treat emitted items only as candidates and do not interpret zero review tasks as zero uncertainty.
Create a genuinely blind benchmark after freezing taxonomy, questions and thresholds; use independent human annotators and a separate adjudicator.
Measure same-input repeat consistency before making claims about stability.
Do not invoke DeepSeek V4 Flash fallback until Polza confirms the underlying model revision and the user approves a separate call budget.
